messages.subject_clean: Introduction | GSoC 2019 | Grinnellian ecological niches and ellipsoids in R
messages.body_plain:
Hello Everyone,

I am Akshay Ravindra Borse, currently in final year of B.E. (Information Technology) at K. K. Wagh Institute of Engineering Education and Research, Nashik, India. I am very well versed with programming languages like C, C++, Python, R and Java. I am very much interested in working in the field of AI in future. Currently I am working on a project in domains of Deep Learning and Computer Vision as my final year project.

As being part of GSoC it would be my pleasure to work on the project “Grinnellian ecological niches and ellipsoids in R”. As I read about this project, I felt that we can collaborate as I have the skills required for this project. I have done quite a few machine learning codes in R and Python, so I have a good knowledge about how to handle data and data pre-processing. I have good knowledge of mathematics and geometry. (It would be very much useful in the ellipsoid part of the project).

I would like to be part of this project in GSoC. Kindly guide me through the process on how should I start.

Regards,
Akshay Ravindra Borse

messages.subject: Data-Driven Discovery of GSoC-R Projects - Mentors Needed.
messages.subject_clean: Data-Driven Discovery of GSoC-R Projects - Mentors Needed.
messages.body_plain:
Hi Everyone,

I am proposing a project for GSoC-R 2019: Data-Driven Discovery of GSoC-R projects

The idea is to update this list <https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2017/blob/master/projects.csv> (make names complete and consistent):  https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2017/blob/master/projects.csv
And then, make a static dashboard web page out of it using available open source dashboard templates, and host it on GitHub.

The project hopes to present the past accomplishments of GSoC under R in a way that projects, students and mentors could easily be
discovered and numbers tracked for each year. Trends and insights through interactive visualizations are part of the scope.
Hoping this could help the R Foundation, org-admins and the R community in the long term track progress with GSoC-R.

The idea page <https://github.com/benubah/gsoc-test/blob/master/gsoc_idea.md> for detailed explanation could be found here: https://github.com/benubah/gsoc-test/blob/master/gsoc_idea.md
Background work <https://benubah.github.io/rcentral/gsoc.html> on this could be found here: https://benubah.github.io/rcentral/gsoc.html

The R org-admins are aware of this proposal.

I'm looking for mentors for this project.

Would be delighted to hear from any interested mentors.

Thank you and best regards,
Benaiah Ubah

* You can use other programming languages on same folder (R with Python, R with Javascript)
